name: Lucie Stella Ecarlate
original_name: リュシイ・ステラ・エカルラート
source:
"I beg you, please be my groom!!"

Likes: [url=/c125620]Shinra[/url]

A transfer student from France, she is fluent in Japanese and has come to exterminate the witches. Blond hair, blue eyes, attractive, and outstanding figure, even though she is very earnest​ and orderly, she actually has poor sense of direction and her careless parts stand out in many ways.

Since Shinra and his childhood friends had visited the witch's house when they were young, she makes contact with them, hoping to gain more information, but before she knows it, she becomes a part of their group.

Due to her being raised in an old-fashioned family, she has a strong sense of virtue​ and thinks that she must marry the person who has seen her nakedness. Because Shinra can easily sees hers, she ardently approaches him in order to make him her groom.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/character/]official website[/url]]
